build.apiScope: isolated synthetic knowledge-workbench-synthetic / 认知示例; no business database
build.browserZoom: 75% IAB device scale; CSS viewports were measured from window.innerWidth and innerHeight

performance.environmentNote: The IAB frame cadence was not stable across repeated foreground runs. The same 47/138 view once produced a 9 ms median / 11 ms p95 and later produced 33 ms / 37 ms at the selected visible tab; the 200/500 scene likewise moved from 8.3 ms / 9.2 ms to 33 ms / 34.3 ms. The R1 <=20 ms target is therefore not proven on a stable foreground runtime.

warnings: THREE.Clock deprecation warning emitted by the installed rendering stack
Cytoscape rejected shadow-blur, shadow-color, and shadow-opacity style properties in the 2D path

limitations: The independent review reached 85.0 when using the fastest performance sample. Repeating the same frame checks under the selected visible IAB produced a 33 ms median, so the conservative structured total is 83.0 and remains below threshold.
Reduced-motion behavior was implemented and inspected in code, but the operating-system media preference could not be changed in this environment, so it is recorded as not_run.

Foreground and stress frame pacing varied between roughly 9 ms and 33 ms medians across repeated runs. Results are specific to this Mac/IAB runtime and the synthetic graph sizes, and the R1 continuous frame target remains unproven.
The current API still does not expose an authoritative graph-as-of or cursor projection, so the evolution view remains a single-object published-version comparison rather than whole-network history.
All data are the isolated synthetic engineering fixture. This review does not establish real semantic quality, reader comprehension, business effect, deployment, or user visual acceptance.
